 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. We're almost underway here at Bobby Dodd Stadium. The Eagles are looking to build on last week's performance with another conference win and getting within striking distance of a bowl appearance (look at us, who would've thought). The Jackets, meanwhile, are trying to avoid the bottom falling out. They put together a solid second half especially on offense, and are fully capable of putting up points if they can get over some red zone struggles. Defensively, they've struggled to get off the field, so they can't afford their offense to not keep pace. The Eagles will be without start running g back Evan Dickens, who is out for the season after injury last weekend. Georgia Tech lead running back Justice Haynes will return, but two key defensive pieces are likely out. 
I'm expecting a close one here, but BC is every bit capable of pulling out the win with the way the defense has looked and with McKenzie's baller-ness.
 Who: Boston College Eagles (3-3) vs Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets (2-4)
 Where: 
 When: Saturday October 24, 2026
